BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Agriculture & Natural Resources.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to commercial shellfish fees; and adding a new section to chapter 69.30 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 69.30 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) The department shall not increase fees above the amounts established as of June 30, 2025, for:
(2) The department shall not impose any additional licensing or use fees for commercial shellfishers, shellstock shippers, and shucker-packer plants through June 30, 2027.
